No Ghidra address residue: the suffix 'subframe_idx' is semantic, not a hex of this or any address. Matches the sibling data_fd2_graphics_figani_pose_anim_pose_idx @ 0x540FD naming. Ghidra symbol byte-identical with src/globals.h declaration.
purpose: FIGANI pose-loop animation sub-frame counter: current sub-frame within the active pose during the pose x sub-frame walk driven by fd2_step_figani_pose_animation.
logic_summary: Per-frame runtime state for fd2_step_figani_pose_animation @ 0x2B9A1 (sole accessor). When palette_op != 0 the stepper blits the current pose then INCs this sub-frame counter (INC byte ptr [0x540FC] @ 0x2B9ED); if the new value is still < the active pose's sub-frame count (figani[+6 + pose_idx*4 metadata]) it returns (stays within pose); otherwise it advances pose_idx and resets this counter to 0 (MOV byte ptr [0x540FC],0 @ 0x2B9FE). On the rewind / wrap path (palette_op == 0, or pose_idx wrapped past the pose count) both counters reset to 0 (reset of this byte @ 0x2B9B7). Disassembly confirms byte-only access, zero-extended on read (MOVZX EDX,byte ptr [0x540FC] @ 0x2B9F3).
element_semantics: Single unsigned 8-bit counter = current sub-frame index within the active FIGANI pose (range 0..pose.sub_count-1). Not an array; scalar runtime state.
